text: I like trying things I have never done before
I enjoy ideas and topics that have nothing to do with my syllabus
I often imagine how something could be done a completely different way
I finish my work well before the deadline
I keep my books, notes and desk in order
I stick to a plan once I have made one
I start conversations with people I have just met
I feel energised after a day spent around a lot of people
I am happy to speak in front of my whole class
I go out of my way to help someone who is struggling
I try to see an argument from the other person's side
I would rather find a middle ground than win a disagreement
I worry about things that might go wrong
I get upset when plans change at the last minute
I take a long time to settle down after something stressful
